source: comfy/cli_args.py in the installed checkout at ~/lanes/qwen-image-21/comfy/src (the argparse `python main.py --help` renders), version from comfyui_version.py
notes: ComfyUI is the engine where the command line does not name the model. Which DiT, which text encoder and which VAE are loaded are widget values on UNETLoader, CLIPLoader and VAELoader inside the workflow, so the workflow is part of the configuration: a result records the files in args and the graph in raw.payload, and two runs with identical flags can be different measurements. The quantization format is detected from the checkpoint's own `comfy_quant` metadata tensor rather than from a flag, which is why none of the fp8/int8 flags above are set for the int8_convrot and w4a8 cells. Only the options that can move an image number on a single-GPU box are listed; the manager, TLS, CORS, DirectML, oneAPI and partner-node options are omitted. The checkout is a nightly commit past the 0.36.0 tag, so the version string does not identify the build and results carry engine.build (SPEC decision 24).
